githubDescription: Agent governance for ThumbGate: 👍/👎 become Pre-Action Checks that block repeat mistakes before code, money, or customer systems change.
metaDescription: Stop paying for the same AI mistake twice. ThumbGate is machine-speed pre-action defense, feedback memory, and governance for AI coding agents and vibe coding workflows: 👍 thumbs up and 👎 thumbs down on answers, plans, tool choices, and outcomes become history-aware lessons, shared lessons and org visibility, success patterns, actionable remediations, agent surface inventory, and Pre-Action Checks across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, Amp, Cline, and OpenCode.
